gtcsolo.void_absorber.foundation: Use bedrock or deepslate in the foundation, including at least five bedrock blocks.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.no_ocean: No ocean biome above the extraction shaft
gtcsolo.void_absorber.ma_voltage: MA source extraction requires UV voltage
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.1:
Overview:
An advanced machine that extracts abundant, high-quality resources from the bedrock layer. Three modes extract different fluids.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.2:
Details
Machine Performance:
The extraction shaft can be extended to suit the installation. Its length does not affect extraction performance.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.3: All three modes support industrial overclocking. Reduced wear on fluid veins makes the machine suitable for a sustained, large-scale fluid supply.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.4:
Ocean Extraction:
Requires an ocean biome directly above the extraction shaft. At its base MV voltage, it produces 4,000 mB of Salt Water per second.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.5:
Fluid Vein Extraction:
Requires a chunk with a non-depleted fluid vein. At its base EV voltage, output is comparable to an EV Fluid Drilling Rig. More remaining fluid increases output; extraction stops when the vein is depleted. Remaining reserves are shared with other drilling rigs.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.6:
MA Source Extraction:
Requires UV voltage. The careful extraction process produces 100 mB every 10 seconds without overclocking. Extraction does not damage the source, allowing continuous operation.
gtcsolo.void_absorber.introduction.7:
Notes:
・Build the foundation from bedrock or deepslate, including at least five bedrock blocks.
・Switching modes interrupts the current extraction cycle.
